items.label: symptom
items.evidence: Unfortunately, PaperQA's `gen_answer` and `reset` tools have empty parameters.
items.rationale: Reproduction and error; notes empty parameters cause failure, but no location or change in the fix.
items.author: jamesbraza

items.label: symptom
items.evidence: Can we just drop the key `properties` when it's an empty object?
items.rationale: Unconfirmed guess; the reference sets parameters to None, not just dropping properties, and this was shown not to work.
items.author: vietvudanh

items.label: symptom
items.evidence: I just tried removing `properties` like you suggest, so `"parameters": {"type": "object", "required": []},`, and still got the same `INVALID_ARGUMENT` error.
items.rationale: Experimental result of a failed attempt; no fix revealed.
items.author: jamesbraza

items.label: fix_sketch
items.rationale: Proposes removing parameters entirely for tools with no args, which is what the reference does (parameters = None), though it doesn't say where.
items.author: vietvudanh

items.label: fix_sketch
items.evidence: I made https://github.com/Future-House/aviary/pull/188 so we can create a workaround to clobber `parameters` manually in something like a callback.
items.rationale: Describes workaround of clobbering tool parameters in a callback, matching the LDP callback and adjust_tools approach.
